## Experiment: `google/gemini-2.5-flash` — 800 Images (50 per class × 16 classes)

**Experiment ID:** `main-1785272634`
**Dataset:** `2550x3300_50perclass_800/images/` (2550×3300 padded PNGs, 300 DPI)
**Prompt:** `CLASSIFICATION_PROMPT` from `src/openrouter_classifier.py` (baseline, pre-disambiguation)
**Settings:** `max_tokens=1024`, `temperature=0.1`, `reasoning.effort=medium`
**Image size:** `2550×3300`
**Model:** `google/gemini-2.5-flash` via OpenRouter

### Results

| Metric | Value |

### Top Confused Pairs

| Expected | Predicted As | Count |

| specification | scientific_report | 25 |
| form | memo | 13 |
| budget | invoice | 12 |
| form | letter | 11 |
| presentation | news_article | 11 |
| presentation | scientific_report | 11 |
| letter | memo | 8 |
| scientific_report | scientific_publication | 8 |
| file_folder | handwritten | 7 |
| file_folder | scientific_report | 7 |
| form | scientific_report | 7 |

### Key Findings

- **`scientific_report` is massively over-predicted** — 64 false positives from 7 different classes
- **Bottom 3 classes** (form 30%, presentation 36%, specification 46%) account for ~50% of all errors
- Fax cover sheets labeled as `form` are consistently predicted as `memo` or `letter`
- `specification` vs `scientific_report` is the single worst confusion pair (25 errors)
